# Magic Stick

> Magic Stick is a source-available (BSL 1.1) AI appliance by QualityMinds. It brings AI models, applications and central sign-in together on your own infrastructure: dedicated hardware, a cloud VM, an existing Ubuntu VM or an existing Kubernetes cluster. One dashboard manages local models (Ollama, vLLM), external model providers behind a common LiteLLM API, catalog applications and users. You remain responsible for the infrastructure and its operation.

The base platform does not require a GPU: small models run on a supported CPU, external model services can be connected, and local GPU model serving can be added when suitable hardware is available. Core features need no license file; only federated SSO requires activation. Team and organisation use is discussed through info@magic-stick.ai.
